scope: Eight existing lead photos: two T-shirts, three Champion jackets, three pepper sweatpants. Background normalization only.
shopifyApplication: pending root verification; no UI used by this agent

assets.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: OFF SHFT ecommerce lead product photo, background-only edit.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET. Input image 2 is a BACKGROUND STYLE REFERENCE ONLY; do not transfer its hat or its logo.
Change only the background of image 1 to a uniform warm Bone #ECE5D3 (RGB236,229,211) seamless matte studio surface, matching the calm warm background of image 2. Remove all diagonal sunlight bands, foliage shadows and horizon. Retain only a short soft natural contact shadow directly beneath the T-shirt. Background should be warm Bone edge-to-edge with no white corners, border, halo, vignette or gradient bands.
Preserve the T-shirt EXACTLY: same ivory colour, full silhouette, neckline, sleeves, seams, cotton grain, fine wrinkles and folds, garment highlights, artwork placement, scale, shape and colours. Preserve the exact small OFF SHFT logo at the wearer's left chest, including clock O, ink lettering and rust hands.
Keep the original square canvas, full product visible, identical front view, position, framing and scale. Do not crop, reshape, rotate, recolour, relight or beautify the garment. Do not add text, objects, hangers or watermarks. Output one opaque square product image.

qa.notes: Warm seamless Bone backdrop without sunlight bands; same ivory tee silhouette, neckline, sleeve lengths, wrinkles and small chest mark. Full garment visible, no white halo.

assets.cornerMeasurement: Read-only median RGB of 32x32 corner patches, TL/TR/BL/BR; no image transforms saved.
